extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x) = x^n where n is a real number, then f'(x) = nx^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If c is a constant and f(x) is differentiable, then d/dx[cf(x)] = cf'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Sum Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of a sum equals the sum of the derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Difference Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of a difference equals the difference of the derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of how a function changes as its input changes; represents instantaneous rate of change.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A mathematical function of the form a^x where the base is a positive constant.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Base e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The unique number for which lim_{h→0} (e^h - 1)/h = 1, making e^x its own derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The rate of change of position with respect to time, defined as v(t) = s'(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The rate of change of velocity with respect to time, defined as a(t) = v'(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Position
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The location of an object at a given time t.

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The approximate cost of producing one additional unit, defined as MC = C'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of how one quantity changes in relation to another quantity.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point via the tangent line.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The process of finding a function whose derivative is a given function.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The mathematical operation that computes areas, accumulations, and reverses differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and integration, establishing them as inverse processes.

extracted_concepts.name: Real Number Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponent that can be any real number, extending the power rule beyond integers.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The logarithm to the base e, appearing in the derivative formula for general exponential functions.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiable Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function for which the derivative exists at every point in its domain.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit Definition of e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: lim_{h→0} (e^h - 1)/h = 1 defines the unique base e for exponential functions.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A mathematical expression consisting of variables and coefficients, involving only non-negative integer powers.
